verdict_reason: List, pagination and exact reference lookup are covered, but sort is never asserted on the PageRequest so a regression there would go unnoticed.

todos.issue: findAll always builds PageRequest with AggregatedNotificationSort.toSort(sort), but every test passes null for sort and the Pageable captor only asserts page index and size — dropping or ignoring sort would still pass.
todos.fix: Capture Pageable in the list-path tests and assert getSort() equals the default sort for null, plus one test that a non-null sort param (e.g. lastUpdated,asc) is forwarded on the PageRequest.

todos.issue: None of the tests use the required Given / When / Then comment blocks.
todos.fix: Add explicit // Given, // When, // Then (or // When & Then) comments to each test method.
